amendments.because: Owner: do not say Windows is not supported; a Windows bug still gets fixed when it is reported. Add nothing else.
amendments.done_when: Forge's nightly full run and its before-release check run no Windows job, a release no longer waits on Windows, Linux tests on pull requests and the macOS tests stay, and the release notes say Windows is not supported for now.

done_when: Forge's nightly full run and its before-release check run no Windows job, a release no longer waits on Windows, and Linux tests on pull requests and the macOS tests stay.
why: Windows test jobs caused 48 of about 1,000 Forge fixes since 1 Oct (14 in November, about half only test-harness problems), and the Windows release check delayed four releases in a row; the owner chose on 25 Nov 2026 to stop testing Forge on Windows.
